name: BioMeSHClassification
protocol: Deduplicated by doc_id (then by exact text as leakage safety). text = title + '\n\n' + abstract, matching mteb 2.20 SciRepEvalMeSHDescriptorsClassification.dataset_transform. Labels are the 30 most frequent descriptor NAME strings. Seed-42 stratified sample via sklearn train_test_split: 2500 rows, split 2000 train / 500 test (no doc overlap; train feeds the embedder kNN protocol).
